label.zh: 阶段一：纳米机器人研究

note.zh: 4110（进度≥50）选择工程投入档位（max/med/min），之后进度≥200时按档位出现 4130 / 4140 / 4150 之一。
note.en: 4110 (progress >= 50) picks the engineering investment tier (max / med / min); at progress >= 200 one of 4130 / 4140 / 4150 follows by tier.
4210 (progress >= 280) picks the society tier; at progress >= 480 one of 4230 / 4240 / 4250 appears.
4310 (progress >= 520) picks the physics tier; at progress >= 720 one of 4330 / 4340 / 4350 appears.

notes.zh: 4400「新形态」：选择纳米科技、模块化或虚拟化其一，设国家标志 transformation_*；4490（进度≥850）按此标志给出资源并设置回收/丢弃标志；4005 完成时解锁对应传统。
notes.en: 4400 "A New Form": choose nanotech, modularity or virtuality (country flag transformation_*); 4490 (progress >= 850) gives the matching resource and sets the recycle/discard flag; 4005 unlocks the matching traditions on completion.

scope.zh: 机器时代“转变”局势：四个阶段、各阶段研究抉择与每月通知事件、最终形态。
scope.en: The Machine Age "Transformation" situation: four stages, the research choice and monthly notification events of each stage, and the final form.
